## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem, what changes for users or contributors, and why this approach fits the project. Link related issues, if any.

## Validation

List the exact checks you ran and their results. Mention skipped checks and why they were skipped. For documentation-only changes, check wording, links, and whitespace; application tests are usually unnecessary.

## Compatibility and dependencies

Describe any API, migration, configuration, or platform impact. List new dependencies and their purpose, or write "None".

## Screenshots

For visible UI changes, add screenshots when useful. Remove this section if it does not apply.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/irfanadwifangga/yt-to-mp3/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and kept this pull request focused.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes, or explained why they are unnecessary.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation and both UI translations where needed, or explained what does not apply.
- [ ] I removed credentials, session tokens, personal data, and generated build output.
